blocks.source: assert rows_on(q, **{'orders': "SELECT CAST(order_id AS INT) AS order_id, CAST(customer_id AS INT) AS customer_id, CAST(status AS STRING) AS status, CAST(order_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS order_ts, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount FROM VALUES (3, 1, 'p', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00', 10), (1, 1, 'p', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00', 10), (2, 1, 'p', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00', 10) AS orders(order_id, customer_id, status, order_ts, amount)"}) == [(1, 1, '10.00'), (1, 2, '10.00')], 'ties keep two rows only'

assert rows_on(q, **{'orders': "SELECT CAST(order_id AS INT) AS order_id, CAST(customer_id AS INT) AS customer_id, CAST(status AS STRING) AS status, CAST(order_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS order_ts, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount FROM VALUES (1, 1, 'p', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00', 10), (2, 1, 'p', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00', 20) AS orders(order_id, customer_id, status, order_ts, amount)"}) == [(1, '2026-01-01 00:00:00', '10.00', '10.00'), (2, '2026-01-01 00:00:00', '20.00', '30.00')], 'same timestamp still row by row'

assert rows_on(q, **{'events': "SELECT CAST(user_id AS INT) AS user_id, CAST(event AS STRING) AS event, CAST(ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS ts FROM VALUES (1, 'v', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00'), (1, 'v', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00'), (1, 'v', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00'), (1, 'v', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:01') AS events(user_id, event, ts)"}) == [(1, 'v', '2026-01-01 00:00:00'), (1, 'v', '2026-01-01 00:00:01')], 'triple copy'

assert rows_on(q, **{'logins': "SELECT * FROM VALUES (9, TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00'), (9, TIMESTAMP'2026-01-02 00:00:00'), (9, TIMESTAMP'2026-01-05 00:00:00'), (9, TIMESTAMP'2026-01-06 00:00:00') AS logins(user_id, login_ts)"}) == [(9, '2026-01-01', '2026-01-02', 2)], 'tie keeps earliest'
